title: The hGID GID4 E3 ubiquitin ligase complex targets ARHGAP11A to regulate cell migration
authors: Bagci H; Winkler M; Uliana F; Boulais J; Mohamed WI; Park SL; Côté J; Peter M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究泛素连接酶GID4调控细胞迁移的机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The human CTLH/GID (hGID) complex emerged as an important E3 ligase regulating multiple cellular processes, including cell cycle progression and metabolic activity. However, the range of biological functions controlled by hGID remains unexplored. Here, we show that the hGID substrate receptor GID4 regulates cell growth and migration. Biochemical and cellular assays combined with proximity-dependent biotinylation (BioID2) revealed that the hGID GID4 E3-ligase targets the Rho-GAP ARHGAP11A for degradation. Depletion of GID4 or impeding the GID4 substrate binding pocket impairs motility and directed cell movement, whereas knockdown of ARHGAP11A significantly restores the cell migration defect. We found that GID4 controls cell migration by degrading ARHGAP11A thereby preventing its accumulation at the cell periphery where it inactivates RhoA activity. Together, we identified a unique function for GID4, as well as a wide range of substrate profiles beyond Pro/N-degron motifs, which pave the way for deciphering additional pathways regulated by hGID E3 ligase activity through its GID4 substrate receptor.
abstract_zh: 人源CTLH/GID（hGID）复合物已被鉴定为一种重要的E3连接酶，调控多种细胞过程，包括细胞周期进程和代谢活性。然而，hGID所控制的生物学功能范围仍未得到探索。在此，我们表明hGID底物受体GID4调控细胞生长和迁移。结合邻近依赖性生物素化（BioID2）的生物化学和细胞实验揭示，hGID GID4 E3连接酶靶向Rho-GAP ARHGAP11A进行降解。GID4的耗竭或阻碍GID4底物结合口袋会损害运动性和定向细胞移动，而ARHGAP11A的敲低则显著恢复细胞迁移缺陷。我们发现GID4通过降解ARHGAP11A来控制细胞迁移，从而防止其在细胞外周积累，该处ARHGAP11A会失活RhoA活性。综上，我们鉴定了GID4的一个独特功能，以及超出Pro/N-degron基序的广泛底物谱，这为通过其GID4底物受体解析hGID E3连接酶活性调控的其他通路铺平了道路。
